What the template makes, in one sentence:

- [ ] The id is final (a merged id is permanent) and the folder holds `template.json`, `workflow.fugue` and a preview.
- [ ] `bin/check-all <fugue binary>` passes.
- [ ] Every model has a `source` and a `size` in `requires.models`, and any licence limit is in the description.
- [ ] Sample inputs are small and mine to share, with no photos of other people.
- [ ] A carried pack is in `packs/<pack id>/` without tests, at the version `requires.packs` names.
- [ ] I agree this is released under the repo's MIT licence.

See CONTRIBUTING.md. Merged changes reach every Fugue user within hours.
